newsitem.title: USA: MCI licenses Applied Digital system.
newsitem.headline: MCI licenses Applied Digital system.

text.p: Applied Digital Access Inc and MCI Telecommunications Corp on Friday announced a licensing agreement under which MCI will deploy Applied Digital's test operations system in its telecommunications networks.

The system tests wideband and broadband digital circuits and it can be used by technicians from any client workstation at any location. Historically, existing systems are deployed on a variety of diverse platforms.
The Java software-enable system will aid MCI in testing its digital services throughout its network.
Applied Digital shares were up 1-1/8 to 5-1/8 by midday.
